title.en: Providing for the Recognition of Muslim Divorce

text.en:
Divorce among Muslims residing in non-Christian provinces shall be recognized and be
governed by Muslim customs and practices.

This Decree shall take effect as of June 19, 1969.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
